What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to set up a few essential components. First, you'll need to create a GitHub Pages site to host your digital products. Next, you'll need to set up a Cloudflare Workers account to handle backend logic and payment processing. Finally, you'll need to configure NOWPayments to integrate with your Cloudflare Workers account. With COREMERCH's Complete Builder Kit, you'll get a comprehensive blueprint for setting up each of these components, as well as step-by-step instructions for integrating them with your payment and delivery pipeline.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure NOWPayments to integrate with your Cloudflare Workers account. This involves setting up a webhook to notify your Cloudflare Workers account of incoming payments, as well as configuring your Cloudflare Workers account to process payments directly on-chain. You'll also need to set up a file delivery system, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to deliver your digital products to customers.
